title: Perform an independent read-only code review of the current uncommitted Windows localization impl...
goal: Perform an independent read-only code review of the current uncommitted Windows localization implementation for Important/Critical issues only. Review DesktopPet.Core/I18n/I18n.cs, all four Core Resources/i18n*.json catalogs, App/Localization/WpfLocalizer.cs and LanguageCoordinator.cs, App.xaml.cs language publication, and localized WPF surfaces Settings/Chat/FloatingBall/Welcome/SpritePreview/Pet/Tray/Danmaku plus AiCoordinator/HotkeySettingsCoordinator/PersistenceErrorPresenter. Requirements: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese; persist before publish; immediate refresh of all currently visible static UI; user/model content, prompts, logs, style keys never translated; formatted placeholders preserved; no mixed-language page. Inspect tests. Do not modify files. Report findings ordered by severity with exact file:line evidence, or explicitly review-passed; include residual native UI smoke gaps.
summary:
## Review

- Correct: `LanguageCoordinator.ChangeLanguageAsync` persists settings before calling `_i18n.SetLang` and `_publish` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Localization/LanguageCoordinator.cs:44-66`. The persistence-before-publication tests pass.
- Correct: Existing placeholder checks pass for keys present in the English catalog. AI prompts, model output, user text, and diagnostic log messages are generally kept outside the localization path in `AiCoordinator.cs`.
- Blocker: **English catalog is incomplete, causing widespread Chinese text in English UI.** `i18n.en.json` ends at line 347 and contains 345 keys, while `i18n.zh.json` contains 704 keys, `i18n.zh-TW.json` 709 keys, and `i18n.vi.json` 704 keys. The non-English catalogs contain 359, 364, and 359 keys respectively that are absent from English. For example, the current Settings surface uses `"我的宠物"` and `"添加宠物"` at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/Settings/SettingsWindow.cs:823-840`, but these keys are absent from `i18n.en.json`. `I18nService.T` returns the key itself when English has no entry at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/I18n/I18n.cs:54-67`, so English displays the Chinese source text. This violates English support and produces mixed-language pages.
- Important: **The completeness test cannot detect the missing English entries.** `I18nService.UiCatalogKeys` is derived exclusively from the English dictionary at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.Core/I18n/I18n.cs:77-80`; `I18nTests.UiCatalog_IsCompleteAcrossAllFourLanguages` only iterates that set at `windows-native/tests/DesktopPet.Core.Tests/I18nTests.cs:62-71`. Consequently, the 359/364 non-English-only keys are excluded from the assertion. Placeholder tests have the same blind spot for those keys.
- Important: **Language publication does not refresh every currently visible surface.** `App.PublishLanguage` only refreshes the manager, tray, and chat window at `windows-native/src/DesktopPet.App/App.xaml.cs:503-511`. `PetWindowManager.App...
